subject: Payment cadence & conditional holdback for BrightLeaf PoC — proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightleaf.io>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@brightleaf.io, procurement@brightleaf.io
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 08:15:00 +0200
Subject: BrightLeaf PoC billing proposal — request for Net60 and 10% holdback

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BrightLeaf is keen to move forward with the PoC. Before we lock dates I'd like to confirm commercial terms from our side. Given internal procurement cycles and our finance policy for pilot vendors, we'd like to request Net60 payment terms for the bulk of consumption, with a 10% holdback retained until final acceptance of the PoC deliverables.

We understand Redwood's standard approach may differ; our preference is driven by our risk controls for first-of-kind integrations. We'll of course provide a PO (I can share a draft PO and VAT cert).

Key asks from BrightLeaf: 
- Net60 on milestone invoices after initial deposit
- 10% holdback until acceptance test completed (expected within 60 days)
- Signed PO (we can issue) and VAT registration evidence for EU tax purposes

If Net60 isn't possible, would Redwood consider Net45 with a reduced deposit? Please loop in billing/legal as needed.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement
BrightLeaf Corporation

Attachments: draft_PO_request.docx (we will send final PO after confirmation)
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightleaf.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf PoC billing proposal — request for Net60 and 10% holdback

Thanks Elena — glad to hear the team's ready.

High-level response from Redwood: we generally require an initial deposit for PoCs to cover onboarding and reserved capacity. For new EU customers we also need a valid VAT certificate and a signed PO. That said, we're open to a middle ground to get the pilot moving.

Proposed compromise from Redwood:
- 20% upfront deposit on PO execution (applied to first invoice)
- Milestone invoicing: 40% after onboarding & integration, 30% after acceptance testing, remainder (10%) retained as holdback and released on final acceptance
- Payment terms: Net45 from invoice date (we cannot push Net60 for first engagements without additional credit approvals)
- We will accept BrightLeaf's PO and the attached Redwood proposal will be the basis of the SOW; legal can do a short addendum if needed for the holdback language

I have looped in Marcus from Billing and Laura from Legal to confirm operational feasibility and to prepare the invoice template + addendum. Please attach your VAT cert and PO when ready and we'll produce a DocuSign packet for signatures.

Next steps: can you confirm whether a 20% deposit is acceptable? If not, propose what you can commit to so we can route for approvals.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightleaf.io>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@brightleaf.io, procurement@brightleaf.io
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:27:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf PoC billing proposal — request for Net60 and 10% holdback

Hi Priyom,

Appreciate the quick reply and the concrete proposal. A few clarifications from BrightLeaf: 
- We can accept a deposit but would prefer it to be 10% rather than 20% to preserve working capital for the quarter.
- Net60 remains our preferred cadence given our approval flows; if Redwood needs Net45, we will escalate to our CFO but that will add time.
- Attached is our VAT certificate for the EU entity (see attachment).

If Redwood can move to 10% deposit + Net60, we can sign immediately and issue the PO. If Redwood can't, please have Marcus outline the exact internal approval path (credit limit/finance sign-off) so we understand timing.

Thanks,
Elena

Attachments: VAT_certificate_BrightLeaf.pdf
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightleaf.io>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 14:50:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf PoC billing proposal — request for Net60 and 10% holdback

Elena / team — Marcus from Billing here. Thanks for the VAT file, received. I've reviewed internally with Finance: we can offer a pragmatic compromise to get procurement unblocked while protecting Redwood's exposure.

Billing's counter-proposal (operational):
- 20% deposit remains standard for PoCs; however, we will accept 10% if BrightLeaf provides a corporate credit reference and the PO is issued with a signed payment commitment (we'll need procurement contact + PO number)
- If BrightLeaf cannot provide credit references quickly, we accept 20% deposit + Net45.
- Holdback: we can do a 10% retention released on final acceptance (same wording Priyom proposed).
- Invoice schedule (example):
  1) Invoice 1 (Deposit): 10% on PO execution
  2) Invoice 2 (Integration complete): 40%, Net45
  3) Invoice 3 (Acceptance): 40% less 10% holdback = 30%, Net45
  4) Holdback release: 10% upon final sign-off (one-time credit memo)

I've attached a one-page invoice template and a short checklist of the credit evidence we need (bank reference / recent supplier reference). Please confirm which path you prefer and send the PO number so we can generate DocuSign invoices and the initial invoice.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice_template_redwood.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightleaf.io>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@brightleaf.io, procurement@brightleaf.io
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 16:42:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf PoC billing proposal — request for Net60 and 10% holdback

Thanks Marcus and Priyom — after a quick review with Finance we've agreed to the middle path to avoid delays:
- BrightLeaf will issue PO #BL-7053 today for the PoC. The PO will reference the Redwood proposal and this email thread.
- Deposit: 10% on PO execution (BrightLeaf asks that this be invoiced immediately and paid within Net30)
- Milestone invoices will be Net45 as Redwood requests
- Holdback: 10% retention released after final acceptance testing, to be documented in the DocuSign addendum
- We will also provide a supplier reference (attached) within 48 hours to support faster processing in your ledger

Please generate the DocuSign packet with: SOW + short billing addendum + invoice 1 (10% deposit). We would like invoices to show VAT line items per the attached VAT cert.

I'll upload the PO and supplier ref to your HubSpot link after this message. Looking forward to kickoff next week.

Best regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement
BrightLeaf Corporation
